subject: AI.P1.2i
legal_basis_considered: Annex I Part I point (2)(i); Article 13(3), (4)
guidance_considered: FAQ: does a manufacturer need to implement all the essential requirements?
analysis: The device communicates only with its own backend over a bounded retry schedule and cannot be directed at third-party networks; the risk assessment documents this and the justification will be included in the technical documentation.
limitations: Firmware review only for the retry logic; no traffic generation test.
